skills.description: Add telemetry inside your own code: a span around one of your functions, the business metrics you confirmed, or coverage for the database and queue clients auto-instrumentation misses. skills.description: Read-only audit of existing OTel coverage, semconv conformance, and cardinality risks

skills.name: otel-init
skills.description: First-run setup for lasting observability: scan the repo, detect service boundaries, and prime the context cache. Not for diagnosing one slow or failing request.

skills.name: otel-instrument

skills.name: otel-local
skills.description: See this service's traces, logs and metrics on your machine: start a free local Grafana stack (grafana/otel-lgtm) in Docker and point the service at it. Not for diagnosing one slow or failing request.

skills.name: otel-remediate
skills.description: Propose a deployment-config diff for a service /otel-instrument can't bootstrap (generatorSupported:false, inScope:true)

skills.name: otel-test
skills.description: Generate a test that fails when a service's telemetry goes missing: it sends one request through the service and asserts the request's span, the spans /otel-enrich added and the confirmed business metrics all came out. No backend, nothing leaves the machine. For Node.js and Python services that /otel-instrument has already set up.
